title: Python AI工程学习之旅：从基础到LLM与Agent
summary: 该GitHub仓库记录了从Python基础到AI工程的完整实践学习路径，涵盖数据分析、机器学习、深度学习、生成式AI、LLM、RAG与AI Agent，并包含笔记、面试准备与实战项目实现。
summary_en: A hands-on GitHub repository documenting a complete journey from Python fundamentals to AI engineering, covering data analytics, ML, deep learning, generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and AI agents with notes, interview prep, and practical projects.
